name: Shenzhen Ldrobot Co., Ltd
summary: Shenzhen Ldrobot Co., Ltd manufactures robotics and artificial intelligence technology products in China. Its products include LiDAR Sensors, robot navigation and motion control solutions, robotic vacuum cleaners, robot lawn mowers, room service robots, restaurant service robots, inspection robots, and logistics robots. The company's products uses in home cleaning, commercial, industrials, and embodied application. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
